NewsArticle.Title: Sgath and Rucesion
NewsArticle.Content:
Rucesion citizens may go behind the Justice hall to be teleported to the Sgath pit. Mileth citizens or others may enter at the Crypt Vestibule.
As before, three demagogues or three guards are required to summon the great horrible being that is best unmentioned lest it should appear: Sgath, the Shadow Hunger. Kieran, the ghoul of the Sgath Pit, will respond to officials of any village.
